description: Type the tier rejection of sandbox network settings. Organizations on Daytona's lower tiers have restricted egress, and the API rejects networkAllowList / domainAllowList / networkBlockAll with HTTP 400 "Network access is restricted and cannot be overridden at the sandbox level. Remove domainAllowList from the request." (observed live 2026-11-03 on createSandbox; https://www.daytona.io/docs/en/network-limits/#tier-based-network-restrictions).

traits.smithy.api#documentation: The organization's tier restricts network access, so sandbox-level network settings are refused (HTTP 400).
